numbering_rule_used: depth = 1 + number of numbering components, where a component is the leading alpha code/letter/roman-numeral plus each subsequent dot-separated digit group. 'PARTIE n' = 1 component -> level 1. A single letter or roman numeral ('A.', 'I.') = 1 component -> level 2. A code with numeric groups ('C.1', 'UG.1', 'UGSU.2.4', 'N.1.2.2') = component count of (code + each .digit group) -> level = 1 + count (e.g. UG.1 -> 2 components -> level 3; UG.1.4 -> 3 -> level 4; N.1.2.2 -> 4 -> level 5). Unnumbered ALL-CAPS lines (e.g. 'ZONE URBAINE GÉNÉRALE (UG)') are treated as level 2 zone headers, siblings of lettered PARTIE subsections. Unnumbered non-caps lines (e.g. 'Caractère de la zone urbaine générale') are nested one level below whatever node is currently open on the stack (here: level 3, sibling of the zone's first numbered subsection).
